item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00423","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C09","C01","C13"],"selected_candidate_label":"C09","confidence":0.86,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C09 plausibly supplied a material template for the child. Both proclamations commemorate a centennial, invoke congressional action, request governmental agencies to cooperate in observances, then broaden participation to educational or other institutions and describe the commemorative purpose with an \"all/to the end\" clause. This parallel sequence and adapted language are more concrete than generic proclamation boilerplate. C01 closely parallels the joint-resolution predicate and request that agencies cooperate with a named institution, while C13 has a similar two-stage government-cooperation and broader-observance structure, but neither matches the child's centennial program as fully as C09.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"the Congress, by a joint resolution approved August 25, 1961, has requested the President to issue a proclamation recognizing the centennial","parent_excerpt":"By a joint resolution approved on September 7, 1957 ... the Congress established the Civil War Centennial Commission ... and requested the President to issue proclamations","explanation":"Both use a congressional joint resolution requesting a presidential proclamation as the immediate predicate for a centennial observance."},{"child_excerpt":"I request that the agencies of the Government cooperate with the land-grant universities and colleges throughout the academic year 1961-1962 in recognizing","parent_excerpt":"I request all units and agencies of government--Federal, State, and local--and their officials to encourage, foster, and participate in Centennial observances.","explanation":"The central operative machinery is parallel: government agencies are asked to cooperate in or participate in an extended centennial program."},{"child_excerpt":"I also request that such centennial be otherwise appropriately celebrated to the end that the occasion may serve to commemorate","parent_excerpt":"I especially urge our Nation's schools and colleges ... to plan and carry out their own appropriate Centennial observances ... all to the end of enriching our knowledge and appreciation","explanation":"Both follow the government-agency request with a broader call for appropriate centennial observances and conclude by stating the educational or commemorative end those observances should serve."}]}
